high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a text excerpt from an article or book. The text discusses the behavior of sick bees and how they leave their nests earlier to forage, thereby reducing the risk of infecting other bees. It mentions that this early departure is an act of altruism, as it helps prevent the spread of disease within the hive. The text also references a study by Woyciechowski, which argues that in honey bees and other social insects, individuals with lower life expectancy undertake more risky tasks even in the absence of disease.
